lines.t: I don't know what to say
I don't know what to say
Lights flicker, pulse in my chest
Life races like a sequencer
But power comes when I lay myself to rest
Mirrors glitch, I can't see clear
Pride rewinds, what I need to hear
Self-made thrones, dust in the floor
Disconnected from the source
I wanted more, but the void can't be had
No cheat code here
Only union brings the light, yeah
Let the beat slow down
Breathe in the silence
Spirit moves like a waveform
To find a lion
Union of fire
Cycles in my veins, miracles sparking
When I call your name, every drop is hard
Grace rewrites the code, yeah, who's you?
You make me bold, drop the pride
Face shakes through
Power and surrender
Spirit breaks through
Smoke swirl, mind spin
But peace breaks in when confession begins
No script for this, just spirit's design
Miracles rising with hands off the line
Empty striving, let it fade
True earth comes when ego's slain
Union with Mashiach over hollow acclaim
Let the bass hit, every fear put to shame
Union of fire, rushing like sound
Spirit unleashed, let my walls fall down
You color in the silence, you break every chain
Yahushua, breathe in my brain
No algorithms, just surrender
Let every rhythm call me back to center
Let the fire fall, every beat an answer
Miracles in the drop, spirit as my dancer
Close reset, union remains
Every miracle's coded when I let you ring
Thanks for watching!
